/--
The homogeneous version of `HAnd`: `a &&& b : α` where `a b : α`.
(It is called `AndOp` because `And` is taken for the propositional connective.)
-/
class AndOp (α : Type u) where
  /-- The implementation of `a &&& b : α`. See `HAnd`. -/
  and : α → α → α
